reviews.title: Perfect Small Budget PC Case *(with one minor issue)*
reviews.comment: Due to the limited size of my room, a small PC is all I wanted. I searched through the expensive, more popular brands (such as Fractal Terra) and figured anything above 100 was eating into my budget. Then I saw this PC case. At the time it had no reviews on Amazon but it looked perfect in terms of design and size, so I took a chance. A chance that came good, perfect infact. For 50 bucks, the PC case was easy to build in and easy to cable manage surprisingly. People mention the material being easily bendable but it's sturdy and solid. The description mentioned the case being mini-ITX and micro-ATX compatible but I went for a micro-ATX motherboard which ended up taking the entirety of the inside in a snug and comfortable way. *(Now for one minor gripe that I can't overlook. The two top fans and the side fans fit perfectly, aka the three pre-installed fans, but adding the bottom two fan was annoying. I had to manually widen the screwholes to get the fans screwed down.)* Moving away from that issue, I had to go with a smaller dual-fan 5060 TI gpu since the space is limited, but for what I play, it's absolutely perfect. So please don't get this if you plan on having any gpu size above 280mm. Air Flow is nice, I have three intake and two exhaust fans which keeps the whole things nice and cool. This will be my case for a good while, what an affordable and absolutely amazing option for budget builders.
reviews.author: Ben The Customer

reviews.title: Cheap and good looking but not a premium case
reviews.comment: For the price, I love it. It looks good and is super cheap. However, I did get a metal splinter during the build, and trying to reach in to plug in a header cable after the cooler and fans are installed is difficult. The metal is thin and doesn't withstand much abuse. The glass is nice and has protective plastic on both sides, which is good. Overall, for the price, it's a pretty great tiny case. I would build in it again. Just don't expect a premium experience, and you won't be disappointed.
reviews.author: Cc

reviews.title: Great MATX case for GF
reviews.comment: GF needed a new PC case that could fit on her narrow desk shelf. This case is extremely light weight but well built. The side panels come off easy and the cable management space is pretty good too. There is room to add two more fans otherwise the airflow isn't terrible and to be expected for a case of this size. Would recommend for anyone building a budget, space-restricted build.

reviews.title: Good looking small case!
reviews.comment: Great case for the price, works great with matx motherboards and fit the graphics card fine, probably won’t fit any three can cards but the msi armor dual fan cards fit perfectly. Only thing I didn’t really like was that the fans are rgb but static they don’t have the wavy style of lighting that most rgb products have, they are just fixed colors. But at this price any included fans are worth it!
